note: What each factor of battles.md section 5 is worth. Every figure is a tuning target section 12 names: want-per-head for guns, tools and horses and each one's multiplier, what leadership is worth, the three terrain tiers and the two fort tiers. None of them is measured, because nothing raises a company yet and there is nothing to measure. Terrain and fortification appear here and nowhere else - a defender's bonus applied again at resolution would be double-counted, and the letters would then describe a mismatch that did not happen.
